keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «얼굴 없는 차장이 한 명만 탈 수 있다고 했다(문제)» 와 «친구들이 손을 잡고 모든 빛을 모았다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (a faceless conductor said only one passenger could get on) and the solution (the friends held hands and joined all their lights). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: How did the friends know the faceless conductor was lying?
qs.qko: 친구들은 얼굴 없는 차장이 거짓말을 한다는 것을 어떻게 알았나요?
evs: Mira lifted her lantern, and the whisperleaf went dark at once.
At midnight, the green train arrived, but its windows were black and no one was inside.
The bright light broke the chains, and the faceless conductor melted into the water.
After Elric came back, his silver light grew weaker every day.
why: 시리즈에서 배운 것처럼 속삭임잎은 진실에만 빛나요. 차장의 말을 듣자 «속삭임잎이 곧바로 어두워졌다» 고 했으니, 거짓말이었어요.
As we learned in the series, whisperleaf glows only for the truth. «The whisperleaf went dark at once», so the conductor was lying.

qs.q: In «cold fog wrapped around Elric like chains,» what does this show?
qs.qko: «cold fog wrapped around Elric like chains» 는 무엇을 보여 주나요?
opts: The fog held Elric so he could not move
evs: The bright light broke the chains, and the faceless conductor melted into the water.
Then a real conductor, an old man with a gentle smile, appeared and checked two tickets.
"He must ride the midnight train tonight, or he will turn back into fog," the headmistress said sadly.
A tall conductor with no face stepped down and said, "Only one passenger may get on."
why: 나중에 «밝은 빛이 사슬을 끊었다» 고 했어요. 안개가 사슬처럼 엘릭을 «꽁꽁 묶어 움직이지 못하게» 했다는 뜻이에요.
Later, «the bright light broke the chains». So the fog held Elric tightly, and he could not move.

qs.q: Why did the headmistress get on the train with Elric?
qs.qko: 교장 선생님은 왜 엘릭과 함께 기차에 탔나요?
opts: The second ticket was hers, and she wanted to keep an old promise
She wanted to visit the lake
The real conductor told her to leave the school
evs: One ticket said "Elric", and the other said "Oriel", the headmistress's own name.
"I missed this train a hundred years ago," she said, "but it is never too late to keep a promise."
"He is lying! He wants to take Elric back into the lake," Theo shouted.
At midnight, the green train arrived, but its windows were black and no one was inside.
why: 두 번째 표에는 «오리엘», 교장 선생님의 이름이 있었고, 그녀는 «100년 전에 이 기차를 놓쳤지만 약속을 지키기에 늦지 않았다» 고 했어요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
The second ticket said «Oriel», the headmistress's name, and she said she «missed this train a hundred years ago» but it is «never too late to keep a promise». You need both sentences.

ends: Who will lead Thornmere Academy now that the headmistress is gone?
교장 선생님이 떠난 쏜미어 마법학교는 이제 누가 이끌까?
Where does the green train go after midnight?
자정이 지난 초록 기차는 어디로 갈까?

write.src: “It is important to <u>keep a promise</u> because <u>people trust us</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «중요한 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what is important and your reason in English.

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because friends help each other)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because friends help each other)
